title: Hero Emote Lock
description: A four-image reference-led character series establishing one recognizable hero and extending her into smile, taunt, and victory-pose assets.
creative_direction: Image 01 locks the hero identity, costume silhouette, and render language. Images 02-04 must preserve the same face, hair base, body proportions, and personality while changing expression energy, gesture, and staging for emote and victory surfaces.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-character-sheet first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04 so the later images preserve the same hero identity while exploring different micro-asset expressions.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
